1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use Change Salary for off-cycle salary changes: retention, reclass, market, counteroffer, equity, or an FTE change.

Start from the Quick Action, or search the employee's name and open the action from their record. Both reach the same screen.

Use this whenA salary changes outside the annual increase process.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Reasons you'll use most
ReasonWhen
RetentionKeeping a flight risk. The most common outside annual increases.
ReclassRole reclassification. Also common.
MarketPay adjusted to market. Less common.
Counteroffer, EquityAs named.
Central HR updateCatch-all that needs documentation. Used for an FTE drop, such as 1.0 to 0.75 for an accommodation.
Exempt / non-exempt changeStatus change in either direction (FLSA exempt salary or FLSA non-exempt hourly).
Change in working hoursSalary only. Change the hours too: use Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

  • Signed letter (for example, a retention letter), filed as a Compensation Letters document record Attach
  • Comments and attachments your finance approver expects If finance asks

To confirmWhich salary change reasons require which document.

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • The effective date is when the new salary starts.
  • The reason matches the change. Annual increase and union reasons are not for off-cycle changes.
  • The new amount or percentage is right.
  • Hours changing too? Use Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Cutoff

Monthly (exempt) pay: the change must be fully approved by the payroll cutoff, around the 18th and earlier in December. It is the HCM Transaction Cutoff on the payroll calendar. Pending approvals do not pay. A change still waiting in approvals at the cutoff misses that payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You.
  • Who approves: Many departmental finance approvers review these. To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Payroll picks up the approved salary in the payroll period it falls in. A backdated change pays later as retro.

Watch-outs

  • Annual increases and union requests have their own reasons. Don't use them for off-cycle changes.
  • Direct-hire reasons (no requisition) appear in the list. Ignore them here.
  • Oracle needs little in comments and attachments, but many departmental finance approvers want more. Confirm what your finance partner expects before you submit.
  • Exempt (monthly) payroll cutoff is around the 18th, usually the 15th to 18th, and earlier in December. The payroll calendar is the source of truth.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood Change Salary page fields (25C) (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Overview of Document Records (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Change salary

Use when: A salary changes outside the annual increase process. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Change Salary for the employee.
    • Quick Actions > Change Salary > select the employee, or
    • Search the employee's name > Change Salary.
  2. Enter the effective date: when the new salary starts.
  3. Action: Change salary. Pick the reason.
  4. Click Continue.
  5. Enter the new salary.
    • A new amount (for example, $85,000), or
    • A percentage increase (for example, 2%).
  6. Review, then click Continue.
  7. File the supporting document on the personnel record.
  8. Add comments and attachments, then click Submit.
Reasons you'll use most
ReasonWhen
RetentionKeeping a flight risk. The most common outside annual increases.
ReclassRole reclassification. Also common.
MarketPay adjusted to market. Less common.
Counteroffer, EquityAs named.
Central HR updateCatch-all that needs documentation. Used for an FTE drop, such as 1.0 to 0.75 for an accommodation.
Exempt / non-exempt changeStatus change in either direction (FLSA exempt salary or FLSA non-exempt hourly).
Change in working hoursSalary only. Change the hours too: use Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Before you submit

  • Attach: Signed letter (for example, a retention letter), filed as a Compensation Letters document record (attach). Comments and attachments your finance approver expects (if finance asks). To confirm: Which salary change reasons require which document.
  • Check: The effective date is when the new salary starts. The reason matches the change. Annual increase and union reasons are not for off-cycle changes. The new amount or percentage is right. Hours changing too? Use Change Assignment with Salary selected.
  • Cutoff: Fully approved by the payroll cutoff (around the 18th, earlier in December). Pending approvals do not pay.

Watch-outs

  • Annual increases and union requests have their own reasons. Don't use them for off-cycle changes.
  • Direct-hire reasons (no requisition) appear in the list. Ignore them here.
  • Oracle needs little in comments and attachments, but many departmental finance approvers want more. Confirm what your finance partner expects before you submit.
  • Exempt (monthly) payroll cutoff is around the 18th, usually the 15th to 18th, and earlier in December. The payroll calendar is the source of truth.
